description:
Values for the Rust tests of the coplanar fast path of kaula_planet.rs (plan_phase2D.md section 4.1, test C-R1).

Reference: equations_nbody.tex eq:coplanar (verified in verif/test_coplanar_nbody.py), written here on top of the
validated reference implementation checks/ch8_forms.py (geometry, Love numbers, frequencies) and of the Hansen
coefficients of checks/kaula_lib.py (quadrature, independent of Tisserand's formula used by Rust).

    grad T = G M* R^5 / (a^3 r*^4) [ w_r x^ + w_phi (s^ x x^) ],   x^ = star seen from the planet
    w_r   = sum_q [ 3/4 G_21q Re(kbar_01q e^{i q M}) + 9/4 G_20q Re Z_q ]
    w_phi = -3/2 sum_q G_20q Im Z_q,       Z_q = kbar_20q e^{i((2+q) M - 2 f)}
    F = M* grad T,  Gamma = -r x F;  dissipative parts: kbar -> i Im kbar (eq:Pdiss)

Output: reference_values/kaula_coplanar_values.json (72 states: 3 spectra x 6 eccentricities (0, 1e-6, 0.045, 0.19, 0.39, 0.49: away from the bin edges, remark R5) x 4 obliquities
0, 1e-9, 1e-7, 5e-6 rad, all below the switch i_s = 1e-5 rad).
generator: checks/make_rust_coplanar_values.py (eq:coplanar on ch8_forms, Hansen by quadrature)

love_number_spectrum.formula: rek2 = k2 cos(chi dt), imk2 = k2 sin(chi dt), chi in rad/s
rek2 = k2/(1+(chi tau)^2), imk2 = k2 chi tau/(1+(chi tau)^2), chi in rad/s
